name: Kennedy Space Center Visitor Complex
description: The visitor centre of NASA's Florida launch site, next to the pads that launched Apollo, the Space Shuttle and today's rockets.

items.apollo-csm-block-ii: Command module Kitty Hawk, flown on Apollo 14 (1971)
items.apollo-lm: Lunar module LM-9, built for flight and never flown
items.atlantis: Space Shuttle Atlantis, flown on 33 missions
items.space-shuttle-orbiter: Space Shuttle Atlantis, flown on 33 missions
items.orion: Orion crew module, flown on Exploration Flight Test 1 (2014)
items.saturn-v: A complete Saturn V of real, unflown stages, at the Apollo/Saturn V Center
items.saturn-ib: Saturn IB SA-209, the never-flown Skylab rescue and Apollo–Soyuz backup rocket
items.delta-ii: The last Delta II, built from leftover flight hardware, in the Rocket Garden
items.falcon-heavy: Booster B1023, flown as a Falcon 9 first stage and as a side booster on the first Falcon Heavy (2018)
